sentiment.headline: positive
sentiment.rationale: Official Tesla Manufacturing video shows S/X line fully decommissioned in 46 days and floor cleared for Optimus — concrete execution progress toward the late July/August full-scale start already on the timeline.

positive_signals: Model S/X assembly line decommissioned in 46 days (Tesla Manufacturing, July 10)
Floor space cleared for dedicated Optimus line targeting 1M units/year capacity
Limited Gen 3 production already underway; full-scale output still targeted late July/August 2026
negative_signals: Full-scale production has not started yet — still pre-ramp
Initial output expected to be slow (10,000 unique parts caution remains)

key_metrics.actual: S/X line teardown complete in 46 days; limited Gen 3 production active
key_metrics.target: Full-scale Optimus production late July/August 2026 at Fremont
key_metrics.trajectory: On schedule for summer production start; facility conversion complete

keyChanges.title: Tesla completes 46-day Model S/X line teardown for Optimus at Fremont
keyChanges.description: Tesla Manufacturing posted a video on July 10, 2026 showing the original Model S and Model X assembly line at Fremont decommissioned in just 46 days — concrete pits, robotic arms, and conveyors removed. The post, captioned 'End of an era,' confirms the floor is being repurposed for Optimus. Limited Gen 3 production is already underway; full-scale output on the converted line remains targeted for late July or August 2026 with a long-term capacity ambition of 1 million units per year at Fremont.

sentiment.headline: positive
sentiment.rationale: Remote Self-Driving status in the consumer app is real product infrastructure for owner-operated robotaxi fleets, not just a cosmetic UI tweak.

positive_signals: App 4.58.5 shows live 'Self-Driving' indicator when FSD is engaged
Works on HW3 (not only HW4); vehicle software 2026.20.6.1 ~40% fleet rollout
Directly useful for owners whose cars earn robotaxi revenue
negative_signals: Does not expand fleet size or unsupervised city coverage by itself
Still depends on vehicle software rollout reaching the full fleet

key_metrics.target: Remote fleet management for owner-operated robotaxi network
key_metrics.trajectory: Infrastructure for scaled owner fleet; not yet a volume milestone

keyChanges.title: Tesla app adds live Self-Driving indicator for robotaxi owners
keyChanges.description: Tesla app version 4.58.5 (reported July 7, 2026) displays a live blue 'Self-Driving' indicator under the speed readout when FSD is engaged, plus the glowing blue navigation path. Confirmed working on HW3 Model S. Vehicle-side software 2026.20.6.1 has reached ~40% of the fleet. For owners whose vehicles generate robotaxi revenue, this turns the app into a basic fleet monitor — especially relevant as unsupervised service runs in Miami and other cities.

sentiment.headline: positive
sentiment.rationale: Official confirmation of voice-taught contextual FSD and a September Grok→planning timeline is progress, but it is a roadmap commitment — not a shipped capability yet.

positive_signals: Ashok Elluswamy confirmed voice-taught, remembered contextual FSD instructions (July 8)
Musk: Grok voice commands to FSD planning layer targeted by September 2026
Directly improves last-100-feet robotaxi pickup/dropoff quality at scale
negative_signals: Feature not shipped yet — testing burden for safety (e.g. refusing unsafe commands)
September timeline is guidance, not a release

key_metrics.actual: Confirmed on roadmap; Grok in-car exists but has no FSD authority today
key_metrics.target: Grok voice → FSD planning by September 2026

keyChanges.title: Tesla confirms voice-taught FSD context; Grok→planning by September
keyChanges.description: On July 8, 2026, Tesla VP of AI Software Ashok Elluswamy confirmed Tesla is building a feature that lets drivers teach the car hyper-local context in plain language (e.g. which driveway) with the instruction remembered for future trips. Elon Musk separately confirmed Grok voice commands will pass into FSD's planning layer by September 2026. This is infrastructure for both consumer FSD and robotaxi last-mile pickup quality, but remains unreleased pending safety testing.

trends: Optimus Fremont conversion is execution-complete: S/X line gone in 46 days; full-scale production window (late July/August) now imminent
Robotaxi product stack deepening (remote FSD status, voice context) while physical fleet counts remain the binding constraint
Software/UX for autonomy owners advancing faster than fleet vehicle count or FSD v15 release
No new country FSD approvals or quarterly P&D prints in this 2-day window; next major print is Q2 earnings (July 22)
